# BOOTLEG PTAL

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(shiny)
library(sf)
library(rdeck)

# Make font directory available to Shiny server
addResourcePath("font", "font")

mesh_block_sf <- read_sf('sf_input/final_result.gpkg') %>%
  st_transform('wgs84') %>% 
  select(1:10)

trimmed_scores <- qs::qread('../qs/trimmed_scores.qs') %>% 
  as.data.frame()

source('default_weights.R')

reweight_scores <- function(weights_df) {
  # TODO: Could make this more concise with reduce2():
  # total_score = reduce2(weights_df$amenity, weights_df$weight, ~..1 + .data[[..2]] * ..3, .init = 0)

  mesh_block_sf %>%
    mutate(
      total_score = jobs * weights_df$weight[weights_df$amenity == 'jobs'] +
        total_open_space_area * weights_df$weight[weights_df$amenity == 'total_open_space_area'] +
        n_supermarkets * weights_df$weight[weights_df$amenity == 'n_supermarkets'] +
        n_sport_facility * weights_df$weight[weights_df$amenity == 'n_sport_facility'] +
        n_education_centre * weights_df$weight[weights_df$amenity == 'n_education_centre'] +
        n_child_care * weights_df$weight[weights_df$amenity == 'n_child_care'] +
        n_tertiary_institution * weights_df$weight[weights_df$amenity == 'n_tertiary_institution'] +
        n_hospital * weights_df$weight[weights_df$amenity == 'n_hospital'] +
        n_health_facility * weights_df$weight[weights_df$amenity == 'n_health_facility']
    )
}


```

```{r}
#| context: server

# Reactive weights data frame
current_weights <- reactive({
  tribble(
    ~amenity, ~weight,
    'jobs', input$weight_jobs,
    'total_open_space_area', input$weight_open_space,
    'n_supermarkets', input$weight_supermarkets,
    'n_sport_facility', input$weight_sport,
    'n_education_centre', input$weight_education,
    'n_child_care', input$weight_childcare,
    'n_tertiary_institution', input$weight_tertiary,
    'n_hospital', input$weight_hospital,
    'n_health_facility', input$weight_health
  )
})

# Reactive reweighted mesh block data
reweighted_data <- reactive({
  reweight_scores(current_weights())
})

output$map <- renderRdeck({
  # Initial render with default weights - use isolate to avoid reactivity
  initial_data <- isolate(reweight_scores(default_weights))

  rdeck(initial_bounds = st_bbox(mesh_block_sf)) %>%
    add_polygon_layer(
      id = "mesh_blocks",
      data = initial_data,
      get_polygon = geom,
      get_fill_color = scale_color_quantile(total_score, palette = scales::viridis_pal(), probs = seq.int(0,1,0.1)),
      get_line_color = "#00000000",
      opacity = 0.5,
      pickable = TRUE,
      tooltip = c(
        jobs,
        total_open_space_area,
        n_supermarkets,
        n_sport_facility,
        n_education_centre,
        n_child_care,
        n_tertiary_institution,
        n_hospital,
        n_health_facility
      )
    )
})

observeEvent(current_weights(), {
  rdeck_proxy("map") %>%
    add_polygon_layer(
      id = "mesh_blocks",
      data = reweighted_data(),
      get_polygon = geom,
      get_fill_color = scale_color_quantile(total_score, palette = scales::viridis_pal(), probs = seq.int(0,1,0.1)),
      get_line_color = "#00000000",
      opacity = 0.5,
      pickable = TRUE,
      tooltip = c(
        jobs,
        total_open_space_area,
        n_supermarkets,
        n_sport_facility,
        n_education_centre,
        n_child_care,
        n_tertiary_institution,
        n_hospital,
        n_health_facility
      )
    )
}, ignoreInit = TRUE)
```
